phrase.zh: 每一次前进，都需要看清方向。
phrase.en: Every advance begins with finding a direction.

visual.zh: 俯视起伏折叠的地图，金属罗盘压在折线交汇处，左侧裁切的钢盔在纸面投下深影。
visual.en: A top-down folded map holds a metal compass where folds meet. A cropped helmet at the left casts a deep shadow across the paper.

background.zh:
影片描绘巴顿在二战中跨越北非与欧洲的作战经历。这部1970年的电影获得1971年第43届奥斯卡最佳影片。画面以折叠地图、罗盘和钢盔表达行进与决策，是原创寓意，不是剧照、演员肖像、真实作战地图或电影对白。
第43届奥斯卡最佳影片：巴顿将军。颁奖年份 1971；参评年份 1970。
background.en:
Patton follows the general’s wartime campaigns in North Africa and Europe. This 1970 film won Best Picture at the 43rd Academy Awards in 1971. A folded map, compass and helmet express movement and decisions in an original metaphor, not a film still, actor portrait, operational map or film dialogue.
Academy Awards ceremony 43 (1971), Best Picture: Patton. Eligibility year: 1970.
